title: Quantitative Lemniscate Mergers near Clustered Zeros: Code and Data
description: Reproducible research software and data for inverse-moment bounds, critical-value enclosures, hierarchy certificates, and exact-quadratic sampled root-connectivity experiments. Includes exact inputs, 384-bit ball-arithmetic certificates, 95-digit reference computations, 5376 deterministic raster trials, editable figure scripts, and review records. The accompanying mathematical manuscript remains a working draft; independent mathematical review and comprehensive novelty verification are pending. No superiority over established adaptive contouring algorithms is claimed.
